title: My gifts, my presents
english: On the word [[My gifts, my presents >> Bible:Numbers 28:2]]: if the typical sacrificial observance still stood, it would shut out gospel faith.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.

title: Legal types and gospel faith

title: Diversity of offerings
